lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Codex
    participant MCP as Adashi MCP Server
    participant DB as Project Data Store
    participant Desktop as Tauri Desktop Runtime
    participant UI as Dashboard UI

    Codex->>MCP: perform resource-scoped mutation
    MCP->>DB: conditionally persist through shared resource versions
    DB-->>MCP: committed touched resources and new versions
    MCP->>DB: bump notification-only project change cursor
    UI->>Desktop: poll current project change cursor
    Desktop->>DB: read project change cursor
    DB-->>Desktop: cursor changed
    Desktop->>DB: fetch changed resource snapshots
    Desktop-->>UI: return updated resource payload
    UI->>UI: merge changed records without resetting view state

data.title: Project change cursor and surgical dashboard refresh
